fixture_safety_profile.why_not_synthetic: the ensure INSERTs, so the synthetic profile (DELETE is the only write) refuses it by design; the reset alone also passes a synthetic-style profile with scopeVars = the nine id variables (measured below)

ensure.proposed synthetic: refused: writes other than run-scoped DELETE: insert (expected)

fixture_safety_profile.observation_for_owner: destructiveStatements() captures the table of `delete from public.<t>` as `public`, so a profile's ownership map can never match a schema-qualified DELETE. Not a problem for these profiles (ownership {}), but any ownership-bearing profile is blind to qualified statements. Reported, not changed.

fixture.marker: metadata: qa_run_id, fixture_family = documents_r5_shared_child, fixture_key, external_source = alloy_qa_fixture
fixture.deletes: five per file, each `where org_id = :'org' and id in (<exact \set ids>)`; no prefix delete; no delete of documents, storage, Forms rows, person_health_facts, mutation_events, workflow_events, process_instances, departments or orgs
fixture.transaction: one BEGIN/COMMIT; every guard before it; psql ON_ERROR_STOP, so a refusal or a failure part-way leaves the database unchanged
refusals_both: a fixture id exists in another org
an ac000000- row without this fixture's family marker
a document on a fixture subject (leave through the audited document delete)
a form submission naming a fixture subject (leave through the product lead deletion or qa_documents_forms_residue_reset)
an Enrollment journey on a fixture child / participation
refusals_ensure_only: the permanent QA D1 department is missing
the rows belong to ANOTHER QA run (reset first: one live tenant at a time)
fixture.idempotency: ensure: delete-by-id then insert, safe to repeat within its run; reset: any subset of rows (none, after lead A, after both leads, never-started) is cleaned the same way; a second reset removes nothing and succeeds
fixture.zero_residue: reset asserts, inside its transaction, that no ac000000- row remains in customers / customer_members / work_units / opportunities / opportunity_customer_members in ANY org, and raises (rolling back) otherwise; the runner refuses a result with residue != 0. The supplementary census measures the same plus submissions and documents naming a fixture subject.
fixture.recovery: the reset is not limited to the open run's rows (a run that never reached its reset would otherwise strand them); it returns removed_run_ids so the governed result records whose rows it took
fixture.retained_by_design: audit history of the product lead deletions (mutation_events / workflow_events); never written by the fixture
runner_gates_before_any_connection: production project ref refused; any project ref other than staging refused
FIXTURE_SHA256 pin must match the bytes when set
ORG_ID QA Shared only (Firefly and QA Secondary refused)
